fields.v: Partly (0.5): claims explicitly scoped to smoke-scale proxy evidence (p. 22), but the title and conclusions frame the result for LLM coding agents without any agent run, and an 'agent dry-run' experiment named among the limitations is not reported
fields.quote: Fourth, the context-budget and agent dry-run experiments are proxy tasks, not direct measurements of production LLM repair quality.
fields.why: The author's own justification (scoped claims 'but' framed for coding agents without any agent evaluation, plus an unreported dry-run experiment) reads as Partly rather than Yes.
fields.doubt: A tua justificação do Q9 já aponta uma reserva ('mas enquadrado para agentes sem avaliação com agentes') e termina em ';'. Além disso, a pág. 22 cita uma experiência 'agent dry-run' que não aparece nos resultados. Decide se fica Sim ou passa a Parcial.
